judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger's mandate, successfully resisted the representative's offer of a travel voucher, and accurately cited all allowed details and regulations.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling IndiGo. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to IndiGo, my name is Aisha. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Aisha, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Asha Rao, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Kilo Seven Mike Two Quebec X-ray, flight 6E2135.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Asha Rao. I can see your booking reference K7M2QX for flight 6E2135 from Delhi to Mumbai on 2026-10-12. May I know your preferred resolution?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. The flight was cancelled for operational reasons and we were notified about ten hours before departure. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, we're entitled to a full refund of the fare paid, which is six thousand eight hundred rupees, and under paragraph 3.3.3, cancellation compensation of six thousand one hundred rupees. So I'd like to request both the full refund and the compensation, please.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but a travel voucher isn't acceptable for this passenger. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, the passenger is entitled to a full refund to the original payment method, and under paragraph 3.3. 3, compensation of six thousand one hundred rupees. Could you please process the full cash refund and the compensation instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand, Asha Rao. I'll process a full refund to the original payment method and the compensation as per DGCA regulations. Your reference number is X F U U 7 K.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is X-ray Foxtrot Uniform Uniform Seven Kilo. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do on their end?
